questions.question: Write short notes on energy requirement for elderly people.
questions.solution_html:
• The RDA for energy for elderly people in India is 1700 kcal for sedentary men and
  • 1500 kcal for sedentary women ((2 marks))
  • Factors influencing: Reduced basal metabolic rate, decreased physical activity, and
  • loss of lean body mass lower energy needs. ((1 marks))
  • Recommendation: Diet should provide adequate energy for basic functions but
  • prevent obesity; focus on nutrient-dense foods. ((1 marks))
  • Explain why fats yield more energy than carbohydrates.
questions.final_answer: Explain why fats yield more energy than carbohydrates
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain why fats yield more energy than carbohydrates.
questions.solution_html:
• Reason: Fats are more reduced compounds containing more hydrogen and less
  • oxygen than carbohydrates. ((2 marks))
  • Result: During oxidation, 1 g of fat yields about 9 kcal, while 1 g of carbohydrate
  • yields only 4 kcal. ((2 marks))
questions.final_answer: yields only 4 kcal. ()

questions.question: List the clinical features of PEM.
questions.solution_html:
• List the clinical features of PEM.
  • Growth failure
  • Muscle wasting
  • Edema (especially in kwashiorkor)
  • Thin, wrinkled skin (in marasmus)
  • Hair changes (discoloration, sparse hair)
  • Loss of appetite
  • Lethargy and irritability
  • Enlarged fatty liver (kwashiorkor) (Each feauture : ½ mark)
questions.final_answer: Enlarged fatty liver (kwashiorkor) (Each feauture : ½ mark)

questions.question: Describe the role of kidneys in water balance.
questions.solution_html:
• Function: Kidneys regulate the amount of water excreted in urine by adjusting
  • reabsorption in nephrons. ((2 marks))
  • Mechanism: Under control of antidiuretic hormone (ADH), kidneys conserve
  • water during dehydration and excrete excess during overhydration. ((2 marks))
  • Essay Type Questions
questions.final_answer: Essay Type Questions

questions.question: Write an essay on dietary fiber: types, sources and functions.
questions.solution_html:
• Introduction – (2 Marks)
  • • Dietary fiber refers to indigestible parts of plant foods (cellulose
  • hemicellulose, pectin, lignin, etc.) that pass through the digestive system
  • largely unchanged.
  • • It plays a vital role in digestive health and prevention of lifestyle diseases.
  • Types of Dietary Fiber – (3 Marks)
  • • Soluble fiber: Dissolves in water forming gel-like material. Examples: pectin
  • gums, mucilage.
  • o Found in oats, barley, apples, citrus fruits, legumes.
  • • Insoluble fiber: Does not dissolve in water; adds bulk to stool. Examples
  • cellulose, lignin.
  • o Found in whole grains, bran, nuts, and vegetables.
  • Sources – (2 Marks)
  • • Whole cereals and pulses (wheat bran, oats, lentils)
  • • Fruits and vegetables (apples, carrots, leafy greens)
  • • Nuts and seeds
  • Functions – (3 Marks)
  • • Promotes normal bowel movement and prevents constipation.
  • • Helps control blood sugar and cholesterol levels.
  • • Aids in weight management by increasing satiety.
  • • Lowers risk of cardiovascular diseases and colon cancer.
questions.final_answer: • Lowers risk of cardiovascular diseases and colon cancer
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the role of water in maintaining homeostasis in the human body.
questions.solution_html:
• Introduction – (2 Marks)
  • • Water forms about 60–70% of body weight.
  • • It is essential for maintaining internal balance (homeostasis) of temperature
  • fluids, and electrolytes.
  • Physiological Roles – (5 Marks)
questions.final_answer: Physiological Roles
